indexed_corpus: frozen deterministic MS MARCO passage 1M subset

metric_interpretation.recall_at_10: Recall among positively judged passages that are present in the frozen 1M indexed corpus.
metric_interpretation.success_at_10: Whether at least one positively judged indexed passage appears in the top 10.
metric_interpretation.mrr_at_10: Reciprocal rank of the first positively judged indexed passage.
metric_interpretation.ndcg_at_10: nDCG computed only from judgments whose passages exist in the frozen indexed corpus.

limitations: Only 12.24% of positive TREC DL 2019 passage qrels are present in the frozen 1M index.
Results are conditional on the frozen 1M corpus subset.
Results must not be reported as official full-corpus TREC DL 2019 benchmark scores.
The eligible external set contains 42 queries, so confidence intervals may be wide.
query_exclusion_rule: Exclude external queries with zero positively judged passages present in the frozen 1M indexed corpus. This rule was applied before any Base, PCA, or RARS retrieval outcomes were observed.
